childPolicy.raw: Under 3 sharing with adult(s): free. 3-12 sharing with adult(s): child rate applies. 3-12 in own room (min 2 children): children-in-own-room rate. One child in own room: charged at Single Room rate.

policies.dayUse: 12:00-18:00, excludes meals, charged at 60% of room rate (differs from plain Ole Sereni card's 75%)
policies.payment: Full payment at least 30 days before accommodation date unless special agreement on file; cheques only accepted if cleared in advance
policies.complimentaryTourLeader: 1 bed without meals per 15 full-paying guests, max 4 beds
policies.cancellation: 21 days prior: 50% cancellation fee on first night; 14 days prior: 75% on first night; within 72 hours of noon on accommodation date, or no-show: 100% of net booking value for max 2 nights
policies.releasePeriod: 60 days prior to arrival; rooming list must be forwarded 60 days prior
policies.conferencesExcluded: Rates do not apply for major conferences/meetings/incentive groups - negotiated per case
